1  """Immutable feedback content, optimistic review and atomic idempotent DEV imports."""
    2  
    3  from __future__ import annotations
    4  
    5  from datetime import UTC, datetime
    6  from uuid import UUID
    7  
    8  from sqlalchemy import select
    9  from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
   10  from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
   11  
   12  from packages.agent_runtime.models import AgentRun
   13  from packages.control_plane.audit import append_audit
   14  from packages.core.canonical.json_hash import canonical_json_hash
   15  from packages.core.errors.exceptions import AgentHubError
   16  from packages.core.execution_context.models import WorkspaceExecutionContext
   17  from packages.evaluation.models import EvaluationDatasetItem, EvaluationDatasetVersion
   18  from packages.evaluation.service import EvaluationDatasetService
   19  from packages.feedback.models import RunFeedback
   20  from packages.threads.models import ThreadTurn
   21  
   22  CATEGORIES = frozenset({"FACTUAL", "RETRIEVAL", "TOOL", "LATENCY", "EXPRESSION", "OTHER"})
   23  TERMINAL = frozenset({"SUCCEEDED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED", "NEEDS_ATTENTION"})
   24  
   25  
   26  def require(context: WorkspaceExecutionContext, *permissions: str) -> UUID:
   27      if not context.user_id or any(p not in context.permissions for p in permissions):
   28          raise AgentHubError("FORBIDDEN", "You do not have permission.", 403)
   29      return UUID(context.workspace_id)
   30  
   31  
   32  def audit(session, context, feedback, action):
   33      append_audit(
   34          session,
   35          action=action,
   36          resource_type="run_feedback",
   37          request_id=context.request_id,
   38          actor_user_id=UUID(context.user_id),
   39          workspace_id=feedback.workspace_id,
   40          organization_id=UUID(context.organization.organization_id),
   41          resource_id=str(feedback.id),
   42          safe_metadata={
   43              "run_id": str(feedback.run_id),
   44              "content_revision": feedback.content_revision,
   45              "review_version": feedback.review_version,
   46              "status": feedback.status,
   47          },
   48      )
   49  
   50  
   51  class FeedbackService:
   52      async def _run(self, session, context, run_id):
   53          workspace = require(context, "workspace_read")
   54          run = await session.scalar(
   55              select(AgentRun).where(AgentRun.workspace_id == workspace, AgentRun.id == run_id)
   56          )
   57          if run is None:
   58              raise AgentHubError("AGENT_RUN_NOT_FOUND", "The agent run was not found.", 404)
   59          return run
   60  
   61      async def submit(
   62          self,
   63          session: AsyncSession,
   64          context: WorkspaceExecutionContext,
   65          *,
   66          run_id: UUID,
   67          turn_id: UUID | None,
   68          client_key: str,
   69          rating: int,
   70          category: str,
   71          comment: str = "",
   72          corrected_answer: str | None = None,
   73      ) -> RunFeedback:
   74          run = await self._run(session, context, run_id)
   75          if run.status not in TERMINAL:
   76              raise AgentHubError("FEEDBACK_RUN_NOT_TERMINAL", "Wait for the run to finish.", 409)
   77          if type(rating) is not int or rating not in {-1, 1} or category not in CATEGORIES:
   78              raise AgentHubError("FEEDBACK_INVALID", "Invalid rating or category.", 422)
   79          if (
   80              not client_key.strip()
   81              or len(client_key) > 64
   82              or len(comment) > 4000
   83              or (corrected_answer is not None and len(corrected_answer) > 16000)
   84          ):
   85              raise AgentHubError(
   86                  "FEEDBACK_INVALID", "Invalid feedback length or submission key.", 422
   87              )
   88          if turn_id is not None:
   89              turn = await session.scalar(
   90                  select(AgentRun)
   91                  .join(
   92                      ThreadTurn,
   93                      (ThreadTurn.workspace_id == AgentRun.workspace_id)
   94                      & (ThreadTurn.id == AgentRun.thread_turn_id),
   95                  )
   96                  .where(
   97                      AgentRun.workspace_id == run.workspace_id,
   98                      AgentRun.id == run.id,
   99                      ThreadTurn.id == turn_id,
  100                      ThreadTurn.thread_id == run.thread_id,
  101                  )
  102              )
  103              if turn is None:
  104                  raise AgentHubError(
  105                      "FEEDBACK_TURN_MISMATCH", "The turn does not belong to this run.", 422
  106                  )
  107          answer = corrected_answer.strip() if corrected_answer and corrected_answer.strip() else None
  108          content = dict(
  109              run_id=str(run.id),
  110              turn_id=str(turn_id) if turn_id else None,
  111              rating=rating,
  112              category=category,
  113              comment=comment.strip(),
  114              corrected_answer=answer,
  115          )
  116          request_hash = canonical_json_hash(content)
  117          query = select(RunFeedback).where(
  118              RunFeedback.workspace_id == run.workspace_id,
  119              RunFeedback.created_by == UUID(context.user_id),
  120              RunFeedback.client_key == client_key,
  121          )
  122          existing = await session.scalar(query)
  123          if existing is not None:
  124              return self._same_submission(existing, request_hash)
  125          feedback = RunFeedback(
  126              workspace_id=run.workspace_id,
  127              run_id=run.id,
  128              turn_id=turn_id,
  129              agent_version_id=run.agent_version_id,
  130              created_by=UUID(context.user_id),
  131              client_key=client_key,
  132              request_hash=request_hash,
  133              rating=rating,
  134              category=category,
  135              comment=comment.strip(),
  136              corrected_answer=answer,
  137          )
  138          session.add(feedback)
  139          try:
  140              await session.flush()
  141              audit(session, context, feedback, "feedback.submitted")
  142              await session.commit()
  143          except IntegrityError:
  144              await session.rollback()
  145              existing = await session.scalar(query)
  146              if existing is None:
  147                  raise
  148              return self._same_submission(existing, request_hash)
  149          return feedback
  150  
  151      @staticmethod
  152      def _same_submission(feedback, request_hash):
  153          if feedback.request_hash != request_hash:
  154              raise AgentHubError(
  155                  "FEEDBACK_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT",
  156                  "The submission key was already used for different content.",
  157                  409,
  158              )
  159          return feedback
  160  
  161      async def list_for_run(self, session, context, run_id):
  162          run = await self._run(session, context, run_id)
  163          return list(
  164              await session.scalars(
  165                  select(RunFeedback)
  166                  .where(RunFeedback.workspace_id == run.workspace_id, RunFeedback.run_id == run.id)
  167                  .order_by(RunFeedback.created_at.desc(), RunFeedback.id)
  168                  .limit(100)
  169              )
  170          )
  171  
  172      async def _locked(self, session, context, feedback_id):
  173          workspace = require(context, "workspace_read", "evaluation_manage")
  174          row = await session.scalar(
  175              select(RunFeedback)
  176              .where(RunFeedback.workspace_id == workspace, RunFeedback.id == feedback_id)
  177              .with_for_update()
  178          )
  179          if row is None:
  180              raise AgentHubError("FEEDBACK_NOT_FOUND", "Feedback was not found.", 404)

392      async def _memories(
  393          self, spec: FrozenAgentSpec, *, workspace_id: UUID, agent_id: UUID
  394      ) -> tuple[list[ModelMessage], dict[str, Any] | None]:
  395          """Resolve long-term memory once per run, then never again.
  396  
  397          The first PREPARE selects and writes the chosen ids into
  398          ``agent_runs.effective_memory_snapshot``. Every later PREPARE of the
  399          same run -- a durable approval resume, a replay -- loads exactly those
  400          ids instead of re-querying, including ones that have since been
  401          superseded or invalidated, because the question a replay answers is
  402          "what was this run given", not "what would it be given now". ADR-011.
  403  
  404          The snapshot is an object rather than a list so that "selected nothing"
  405          is distinguishable from "has not selected yet"; both are falsy as a
  406          list, and the difference is the whole determinism claim.
  407          """
  408  
  409          selector = self.service.memory_selector
  410          if not spec.runtime.get("memory", {}).get("long_term_memory", False):
  411              return [], None
  412          if selector is None:
  413              return [], None
  414          snapshot = getattr(self.run, "effective_memory_snapshot", None) or {}
  415          if not isinstance(snapshot, Mapping):
  416              raise AgentHubError(
  417                  "AGENT_MEMORY_SNAPSHOT_INTEGRITY_ERROR",
  418                  "The frozen memory snapshot is invalid.",
  419                  422,
  420              )
  421          frozen = "selected_at" in snapshot
  422          if frozen:
  423              raw_ids = snapshot.get("memory_ids", [])
  424              if not isinstance(raw_ids, list):
  425                  raise AgentHubError(
  426                      "AGENT_MEMORY_SNAPSHOT_INTEGRITY_ERROR",
  427                      "The frozen memory snapshot is invalid.",
  428                      422,
  429                  )
  430              hashed = "memory_content_hashes" in snapshot
  431              invalid_ids = [value for value in raw_ids if not _is_uuid(value)]
  432              if hashed and invalid_ids:
  433                  raise AgentHubError(
  434                      "AGENT_MEMORY_SNAPSHOT_INTEGRITY_ERROR",
  435                      "The frozen memory snapshot contains an invalid memory id.",
  436                      422,
  437                  )
  438              memory_ids = tuple(UUID(value) for value in raw_ids if _is_uuid(value))
  439              memory_hashes = snapshot.get("memory_content_hashes")
  440              if hashed and not isinstance(memory_hashes, Mapping):
  441                  raise AgentHubError(
  442                      "AGENT_MEMORY_SNAPSHOT_INTEGRITY_ERROR",
  443                      "The frozen memory snapshot hashes are invalid.",
  444                      422,
  445                  )
  446              try:
  447                  if hashed:
  448                      selected = await selector.load(
  449                          workspace_id=workspace_id,
  450                          memory_ids=memory_ids,
  451                          memory_content_hashes=dict(memory_hashes),
  452                      )
  453                  else:
  454                      selected = await selector.load(workspace_id=workspace_id, memory_ids=memory_ids)
  455              except MemorySnapshotIntegrityError as error:
  456                  raise AgentHubError(
  457                      "AGENT_MEMORY_SNAPSHOT_INTEGRITY_ERROR",
  458                      "The frozen memory snapshot no longer matches stored memory.",
  459                      422,
  460                  ) from error
  461          else:
  462              selected = await selector.select(
  463                  workspace_id=workspace_id,
  464                  agent_id=agent_id,
  465                  query=self.run.input_text,
  466                  limit=MAX_INJECTED_MEMORIES,
  467              )
  468              await self._freeze_memory_snapshot(selected, workspace_id=workspace_id)
  469              memory_ids = tuple(item.id for item in selected)
  470          metadata = {
  471              "memory_count": len(selected),
  472              "replayed_from_snapshot": frozen,
  473          }
  474          if not selected:
  475              return [], metadata
  476          return [_memory_message(selected)], metadata
